PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3id.org/bricks/context#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE {
  ?s ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
} LIMIT 10

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?meter ?ts ?name ?bldg WHERE {
  ?meter a brick:Electric_Power_Sensor .
  ?meter brick:hasLocation ?bldg .
  ?bldg rdfs:label ?name .
  ?meter ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
  ?tsref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
} LIMIT 30
SELECT DISTINCT ?type WHERE { ?s a ?type . FILTER(strstarts(str(?type), "https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#")) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?meter ?ts ?mp WHERE {
  ?bldg a brick:Building .
  ?bldg rdfs:label ?name .
  ?meter a brick:Electric_Power_Sensor .
  ?meter brick:isPointOf ?mp .
  ?meter brick:hasLocation ?bldg .
  ?meter ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
  ?tsref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
} LIMIT 30

import csv
target="c889cadf-ee1a-5783-816a-c60c58430141"
start="2018-07-18"
end="2018-10-23"
occ=0; unocc=0; n=0
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    rd=csv.reader(f); next(rd)
    for row in rd:
        if row[0]!=target: continue
        ts=row[1]; date=ts[:10]; hour=int(ts[11:13])
        if not (start<=date<=end): continue
        v=float(row[2])
        n+=1
        if 8<=hour<=18:
            occ+=v
        else:
            unocc+=v
print("n=",n,"occ=",occ,"unocc=",unocc,"diff=",abs(occ-unocc))
print("occupied larger" if occ>unocc else "unoccupied larger")
